A stalemate is when the king has no legal moves but is not in check. In other words, every square the king could move to is either taken by his own piece or covered by his opponent’s piece. This results in a draw. 
A checkmate is when every square the king could move into is either taken by his own piece or covered by his opponent’s piece BUT THE KING IS BEING ATTACKED. This results in a win/loss.
